title: NeuroRAD-FM: A Distributionally Robust Foundation Model for Precision Neuro-Oncology.
snippet: Foundation models for neuro-oncology have shown promise for non-invasive molecular characterization and prognostication, yet their clinical utility remains limited by cross-institutional distribution shift and poor performance on under-represented molecular alterations.
